name: playground-template
_comment_overrides: @polkadot-api/json-rpc-provider override is a workaround for an upstream packaging bug (mirrors what product-sdk's monorepo does). The Host API is @parity/truapi (pulled in transitively via product-sdk-host); app code imports the host types/helpers from @parity/product-sdk-host, which re-exports them from @parity/truapi. Still verify the Host API connects in Desktop before shipping (if it hangs on 'Polkadot host is not ready', pin an earlier host/signer set). The former ws ^8.21.0 pin (GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p) was dropped: upstream ranges now resolve past it (smoldot pulls ws >= 8.21).
